_comment: Wave 1 tightened trading mandate — authorization envelope for the paper worker. No secrets.
_usage: Copied to config/mandate.json (gitignored). This file pins the Desk universe plus Alpaca BRK.B alias. SELL always bypasses the allow-list.
_allowed_symbols_note: Desk STOCK_UNIVERSE (74) plus BRK.B. Do not shrink this to mega-caps — that would silently change research_list/Stable. Empty [] would allow all.
_max_notional_note: Coarse cap matching paper $10k book. RiskEngine still applies 25% Kelly / Stage-2 sizing. Null = no cap.
_max_daily_note: Max BUY orders per UTC day. SELL does not count. Null = no cap.
_allowed_sides_note: ['buy', 'sell'] is the default. To freeze new buys, set ['sell'].
